entry.description: Any-angle A*: a cell's parent may be any earlier cell in straight line of sight, so the path is a few long segments instead of 45-degree zig-zags. Line of sight is the runner's own collision rule (every cell a segment touches costs under 253); a segment costs its length times (1 + cost_weight x the highest cost it touches / 252). Written through coco_lab.api with Claude Code as the leaderboard's first submission (R2.6).
